definition: the motion of a liquid or gas as it moves
description: A snowy volcano at dusk with no people. A thick stream of glowing orange lava pours from the top of the slope and runs down the mountainside in a wide river, spilling over rocks in a bright cascade and cutting through the white snow. Hot pieces of rock fly through the air at first, the lava keeps gushing and splashing as it falls, and the crater glows red at the summit. Bare birch trees and a small pool stand in the snow beside the flow, and black lava rocks fill the foreground.
